steps.title: Reference DIESI-SAPL Cast List
steps.action: Reference source file "DIESI-SAPL Cast List" as "sap.diesicst":
steps.notes: Notebook: clean_file(CASTLIST-ATLAS.TXT), the current week's Cast List.

steps.title: Create Column
steps.action: Create new column "Data_Pull" and set value to "Current".

steps.title: Reference sap.diesicst__v2
steps.action: Reference source file "sap.diesicst__v2" as "sap.diesicst_2":
steps.notes: Notebook: clean_file(CASTLIST-PREV-ATLAS.TXT), the previous week's Cast List (Version 2 of DIESI-SAPL Cast List).

steps.title: Create Column
steps.action: Create new column "Data_Pull" and set value to "Previous".

steps.title: Union Sources
steps.action: UNION file sap.diesicst and file sap.diesicst_2, reference as file Cast List

steps.title: Remove Duplicates
steps.action: If file Cast List column "Pers.No." value appears more than once in the column, Keep first record.
steps.notes: Notebook: audit.drop_duplicates(subset=['Pers.No.']) keeps the first row for each Pers.No. (the comment says to drop every duplicated row, but the code keeps the first; Current rows come first because of the UNION order).

steps.title: Create Column
steps.action: Create new column "Error Message".
steps.notes: Notebook: audit['Error Message'] = None. Messages are appended with || when a row matches more than one check.

steps.title: Join
steps.action: FULL OUTER JOIN file Cast List column "Pers.No." and file sap.diesi27 column "Pers.No."
steps.notes: Notebook: safe_merge(..., key='Pers.No.') runs an outer merge, so unmatched rows from both files are kept.

steps.title: Join
steps.action: FULL OUTER JOIN file Cast List column "Pers.No." and file sap.diesi209 column "Pers.No."
steps.notes: Notebook: safe_merge(..., key='Pers.No.') runs an outer merge, so unmatched rows from both files are kept.

steps.title: Join

steps.title: Join
steps.action: FULL OUTER JOIN file Cast List column "Pers.No." and file sap.diesi396 column "Pers.No."
steps.notes: Notebook: safe_merge(..., key='Pers.No.') runs an outer merge, so unmatched rows from both files are kept. (The notebook comment says IT306; the code joins IT396.)

steps.title: IF / THEN
steps.action: IF file sap.diesi27 column "S" is not blank/null AND file Cast List column "PA" is not equal to "2540", "3110", "4014" AND file Cast List column "CoCd" is not equal to "1058" THEN display text response "Research IT0027" in new column "Error Message".
steps.notes: Notebook: research_it27 also excludes CoCd 1058, which the comment doesn't mention.
